ja: コミックボンボンで好評連載中の「SD頑駄無　武者○伝3」に登場する「武者○秘将軍」のプラモデル。「軽装形態」から「武者形態」への鎧装着を再現出来ます。顔面回転ギミックにより、軽装顔から頑駄無顔へチェンジも可能です。矢羽ファンネルの組み換えにより「陣羽織形態」に変形可能、また鎧を組み換えて「鳳凰形態」も再現出来ます。刀、矢羽ファンネルを装備可能です。
en: A plastic model of the "Musha○hi Shogun" that appears in "SD Gundam Musha○den 3" currently being serialized in Comic Bonbon. It is possible to reproduce the wearing of armor from "light armor form" to "warrior form". With the face rotation gimmick, it is possible to change from a lightly dressed face to a rugged face. By rearranging the fletching funnel, it can be transformed into a ``jinbaori form'', and by rearranging the armor, it can also be recreated into a ``phoenix form''. Can be equipped with a sword and arrow funnel.
